title: SpecGate CTSC Target Binding
description: Connects SpecGate discovery, capture, and replay to named Rust or C# implementation targets. Paths are relative to this file.

targets.description: Named targets. The target named 'default' is selected when present; otherwise the first sorted name is used.

package_root.description: Package, crate, or project root relative to the binding file.

runtime.description: Rust async runtime metadata. Omitted targets default to smol.

framework.description: C# target framework override, such as net10.0.

command.description: Optional target command retained for command-oriented CTSC producers.
